rules.description: Building performance factors shall be from Standard 90.1-2019, Table 4.2.1.1, based on the building area type and climate zone. For building area types not listed in Table 4.2.1.1 “All others.” shall be used to determine the BPF.
rules.standard_section: Section G4.2.1.1

evaluations.messages: At least one `output_bpf_set` value must exist.

rules.description: The performance of the proposed design is calculated in accordance with Standard 90.1-2019 Appendix G, where Performance Cost Index = Proposed building performance (PBP) /Baseline building performance (BBP), where both the PBP and the BBP include all end-use load components associated with the building when calculating the Performance Cost Index (PCI).
rules.standard_section: Section G1.2.2

evaluations.messages: At least one `performance_cost_index` value must exist.

rules.description: The Performance Cost Index-Target (PCIt) shall be calculated using the procedures defined in Section 4.2.1.1. The PCIt shall be equal to [baseline building unregulated energy cost (BBUEC) + BPF x baseline building regulated energy cost (BBREC)]/ BBP
rules.standard_section: Section 4.2.1.1

evaluations.messages: At least one `performance_cost_index_target` value must exist.

rules.description: The PCI shall be less than or equal to the PCIt when calculated in accordance with Standard 90.1 2019, Section 4.2.1.1
rules.standard_section: Section 4.2.1.1

evaluations.messages: At least one `pci_target_set` value must exist.

rules.description: When on-site renewable energy generation exceeds the thresholds defined in Section 4.2.1.1, the methodology defined in this section shall be used to calculate the PCI.
rules.standard_section: Section 4.2.1.1

evaluations.messages: Ruleset expects exactly one PBP value to be used in the project.

rules.description: On-site renewable energy shall not be included in the baseline building performance.
rules.standard_section: G3.11 18 Baseline
